answer: The fee is charged through a terrace debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the copper totals, and the beacon anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. At 6 units per epoch, sustaining 314 aliases for 43 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. That is 11 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
